g.text: Layer stack rationale · each layer exists to answer “what state is this employee in?”
Orb-native morphology for the state (tick / wave / tear / gate) — not a DOM chip
Grazing highlight + limb; keeps silhouette readable across states
Attention anchor: size/brightness encode attention (ready large, failed shrunk)
Volume language: spiral / streaks / veins — primary thinking-vs-working channel
Static capture of motion vector: breathe / listen / orbit / gate / shock / tear
Density + coherence encode activity without hue-only coding
Field intensity under body; dormant low, ready/success high, disabled off
Ambient presence volume so the orb “occupies space” when awake
Legend for next round: existing · parameter-driven · renderer-change · new-capability (see CAPABILITY-NOTES.md)
